# BAD-071 — Delete the five vestigial section banners left in the split account-page files (after BAD-054 PR 2)

## Brief
The spike's §4 ranges include each declaration's leading comments, so slicing at them carried page.tsx's old section dividers into the new files, where they now divide nothing. They are a single file's table of contents sitting at the top of single-purpose modules: '// ---- user' is now the first line of _lib/flags-or-null.ts, '// ---- usage' of _components/UsageTab.tsx, '// ---- logs' of _components/LogsTab.tsx, and '// ---- profile' plus '// ---- bits' sit mid-file in _components/UserTab.tsx (the spike itself calls the last two 'leftover'). I deliberately did not drop them: verify-moves.cjs reports every comment that disappears, and dropping them would have replaced step 4's single required 'OK: 20 statements' line with COMMENT LOST output, which the brief treats as a failure.

Evidence: All five present in the tree I am leaving: grep -rn '^// ---' over admin/src/app/accounts/[email]/ hits _lib/flags-or-null.ts:5, _components/UsageTab.tsx:9, _components/LogsTab.tsx:6 and _components/UserTab.tsx (two). Cheapest after BAD-054 PR 2 lands, since PR 2 rebuilds UserTab and its move check runs against the same page.old.tsx baseline: a deletion now would add COMMENT LOST noise to PR 2's run too. Five one-line deletions, no code touched.
